description: This file implements Bluetooth Secure Simple Pairing (SSP) and related security procedures for the Zephyr RTOS, including handling pairing methods, authentication, link keys, and security requests.

methods.name: pin_code_neg_reply
methods.description: Sends a negative reply for PIN code request to reject pairing.

methods.name: pin_code_reply
methods.description: Sends a PIN code reply during pairing.

methods.name: bt_conn_auth_pincode_entry
methods.description: Handles user input of PIN code for authentication.

methods.name: pin_code_req
methods.description: Requests PIN code from user or rejects if not available.

methods.name: get_io_capa
methods.description: Determines IO capabilities for pairing based on auth settings.

methods.name: ssp_pair_method
methods.description: Determines the SSP pairing method based on remote and local IO capabilities.

methods.name: ssp_get_auth
methods.description: Determines the authentication requirements based on remote auth and pairing method.

methods.name: ssp_confirm_reply
methods.description: Sends user confirmation reply for SSP pairing.

methods.name: ssp_confirm_neg_reply
methods.description: Sends negative user confirmation reply for SSP pairing.

methods.name: ssp_pairing_complete
methods.description: Handles completion of SSP pairing, notifying listeners.

methods.name: ssp_auth
methods.description: Initiates SSP authentication process based on passkey.

methods.name: ssp_passkey_reply
methods.description: Sends a passkey reply during SSP pairing.

methods.name: ssp_passkey_neg_reply
methods.description: Sends a negative reply for passkey during SSP pairing.

methods.name: conn_auth
methods.description: Requests authentication for a connection.

methods.name: bt_ssp_start_security
methods.description: Starts security procedure for a connection.

methods.name: bt_ssp_auth_passkey_entry
methods.description: Handles user input of passkey during SSP authentication.

methods.name: bt_ssp_auth_passkey_confirm
methods.description: Handles user confirmation of passkey during SSP.

methods.name: bt_ssp_auth_pairing_confirm
methods.description: Confirms pairing during SSP.

methods.name: bt_ssp_auth_cancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing SSP authentication.

methods.name: bt_hci_pin_code_req
methods.description: Handles PIN code request event from HCI.

methods.name: bt_hci_link_key_notify
methods.description: Handles link key notification event from HCI.

methods.name: link_key_neg_reply
methods.description: Sends a negative reply for link key request.

methods.name: link_key_reply
methods.description: Sends a link key reply.

methods.name: bt_hci_link_key_req
methods.description: Handles link key request event from HCI.

methods.name: io_capa_neg_reply
methods.description: Sends negative reply for IO capability request.

methods.name: bt_hci_io_capa_resp
methods.description: Handles IO capability response event.

methods.name: bt_hci_io_capa_req
methods.description: Handles IO capability request event.

methods.name: bt_hci_ssp_complete
methods.description: Handles SSP completion event.

methods.name: bt_hci_user_confirm_req
methods.description: Handles user confirmation request event.

methods.name: bt_hci_user_passkey_notify
methods.description: Handles user passkey notification event.

methods.name: bt_hci_user_passkey_req
methods.description: Handles user passkey request event.

methods.name: link_encr
methods.description: Enables link encryption on a connection handle.

methods.name: bt_hci_auth_complete
methods.description: Handles authentication complete event.
